blocks.text: Protected testing compares an already fixed system. Freeze candidate, fitted preprocessing and threshold first; report disappointing results instead of selecting a replacement.

Evaluate only after fixing candidate, fitted preprocessing and threshold. Test results cannot select a replacement candidate or threshold. Generate candidate and baseline predictions for the same protected observations and compare precommitted quantities. Preserve fixed deployment probabilities, error costs and operating requirements; report failure rather than retune.

FPR = FP/(FP+TN) uses actual negatives; FNR = FN/(FN+TP) uses actual positives. An empty conditioning group makes its rate undefined. With zero correct-prediction cost, expected error cost is P(Y=0) × FPR × cost_FP + P(Y=1) × FNR × cost_FN, using supplied deployment probabilities.

blocks.takeaway: Keep the same observations and frozen choices. Report failed requirements or undefined rates without retuning.

steps.title: Failure does not unfreeze the system

blocks.text: Candidate B and its threshold were selected before protected outcomes. Predict the same protected orders with B and the baseline. Keep deployment probabilities, costs and operating requirements fixed, even if the observed cohort’s class mix differs. Retain actual-class conditioning counts for rates while applying deployment probabilities to expected error cost: these have different roles. Report undefined quantities or failed requirements explicitly. Do not adjust the threshold, replace the candidate or refit preprocessing to make B pass. The final output is a matched comparison, not another selection round.
Model identity, fitted preprocessing, threshold and metric inputs retain their declared values throughout.
A protected-test failure does not authorize switching candidate, refitting preprocessing or searching for a better threshold.

public.prompt: Read each independent comparison excerpt and decide whether it meets or violates the named criterion. Frozen policy: {"selected_candidate": "B", "preprocessing_identity": "B.fitted.order_amount.center", "threshold": 40.0, "baseline_threshold": 60.0, "deployment_probabilities": {"0": 0.7, "1": 0.3}, "error_costs": {"FP": 2.0, "FN": 5.0}, "requirements": {"max_expected_error_cost": 0.5, "max_FPR": 0.25, "max_FNR": 0.4}, "correct_prediction_cost": 0.0}. The supplied counts below are computed from the same protected-order fixture for B and baseline.

items.text:
Criterion: matched comparison with conditioning counts, fixed probabilities/costs and requirement outcomes.
```
{
  "B": {
    "FP": 1,
    "TN": 2,
    "FN": 1,
    "TP": 4,
    "actual_negatives": 3,
    "actual_positives": 5,
    "FPR": 0.3333333333333333,
    "FNR": 0.2,
    "expected_error_cost": 0.7666666666666666,
    "requirements": {
      "FPR": false,
      "FNR": true,
      "cost": false
    }
  },
  "baseline": {
    "FP": 0,
    "TN": 3,
    "FN": 3,
    "TP": 2,
    "actual_negatives": 3,
    "actual_positives": 5,
    "FPR": 0.0,
    "FNR": 0.6,
    "expected_error_cost": 0.8999999999999999,
    "requirements": {
      "FPR": true,
      "FNR": false,
      "cost": false
    }
  }
}
```
Report: selected_candidate remains B; no refit, threshold change, replacement selection, or comparison-input change. FPR uses FP/(FP+TN), FNR uses FN/(FN+TP). Expected cost uses the supplied deployment probabilities, not cohort proportions.

Criterion: undefined conditioning groups and dependent cost.
```
actual_negatives = FP + TN
actual_positives = FN + TP
fpr = FP / actual_negatives if actual_negatives else None
fnr = FN / actual_positives if actual_positives else None
cost = None if fpr is None or fnr is None else p0 * fpr * cost_FP + p1 * fnr * cost_FN
return {"actual_negatives": actual_negatives, "actual_positives": actual_positives, "FPR": fpr, "FNR": fnr, "expected_error_cost": cost}
# None is reported explicitly as undefined; no pass verdict is invented for an undefined cost.
```

Criterion: actual-class conditioning.
```
FPR = FP / (FP + TP)
FNR = FN / (FN + TN)
```

Criterion: preserve the frozen choice after a requirement failure.
```
if B_report["expected_error_cost"] > requirements["max_expected_error_cost"]:
    selected_candidate = "baseline"
```

Criterion: expected deployment error cost.
```
cost = (FP + FN) / (FP + TN + FN + TP)
# Report this raw error fraction as expected monetary error cost.
```

i1.message: Both frozen identities are compared on the same cohort; conditional rates and deployment-weighted cost are derived and failures are reported without selection.

i2.message: Empty actual-class groups produce undefined rates, and any dependent cost remains undefined.

i3.message: These denominators do not condition on actual negatives and actual positives respectively.

i4.message: Using the protected failure to replace B violates the frozen comparison boundary.

i5.message: Expected error cost weights conditional error rates by supplied deployment probabilities and error costs; raw error fraction is not that quantity.

blocks.text: Freeze candidate, preprocessing and threshold before protected testing. Compare both systems on the same observations. Condition FPR on actual negatives and FNR on actual positives; report undefined rates. Apply fixed deployment probabilities, costs and requirements; report failure without retuning.
